--- title: "Variables of the recoverability (impairment) model: availability in the data" description: "Which variables of the recoverability model are available, partial, missing or out of scope in the VAT (ICMS) legal-entity extract?" date: 2026-11-04 jupyter: python3 --- **Status:** exploration. This entry does not query the extract. ::: {.callout-warning title="Availability is not a recovery rate"} The table records whether a variable can be built from the current extract. It does not measure how much is collected. ::: ::: {#setup .cell execution_count=1} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Source: VAT (ICMS) legal-entity extract, DuckDB read only. Window: 2016–2025. Rows after 2025 stay out of every table and every figure. Suppression: a cell with 1 to 4 distinct CNPJs is pooled as 'others (suppressed)'. A pool that still has fewer than 5 CNPJs is left blank. The count of pooled cells is printed with each table. Q1. Active = RFB code 02 (ATIVA). Inactive = codes 01, 03, 04, 08 (nula, suspensa, inapta, baixada). No establishment match, a root-only match, or any other code = unknown. Unknown is not forced into collectable or uncollectable. Q2. Payment history uses unit cnpj_root, scope vat_icms, denominator enrolled_value. The share is payments over enrolled value in the 5 calendar years that end in the reference year. The threshold is 10%. The unit's CDAs in the December snapshot enter the sum. The history is VAT (ICMS) only. Q3. Reference dates requested: 31 December of 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024. A year with no December snapshot is printed and left out of the tables. December 2024 is a partial snapshot because of a known gap in the DEBITO extract (EQ-05). Later recovery is the next calendar year, and the sum from the next year through 2025, each divided by the December stock. Q4. Precedence: suspended → guaranteed → instalment → unknown → active_history → inactive_history → active_recent → inactive_no_history → active_old. Suspended is uncollectable first. The guaranteed line is always emitted and is empty. no guarantee table in the data; collectable share is understated. Q5. Age bands (0, 2], (2, 5], (5, 10], >10. A value equal to a break stays in the lower band (left-closed is false). Ages from 0 to the first break are the first band. Both readings are shown: the annual paid/stock rate, and the cumulative recovery of cohorts enrolled in the window. The band above the last break is not observable on those cohorts. Q6. The outcome is any payment in the year, the same outcome as model 1 of the payment section. When the eligible frame is larger than 100,000 certificate-years, the fit uses a stratified sample of that size (year, origin, and the payment outcome), seed 2026. Standard errors are HC1. Clustered standard errors by CNPJ root are the column beside them. This is an association. It is not a forecast. Q7. One lab entry per block. Q8. The proposal material reports mean collection 1.38% against a collectable share 27.05%. The material states neither the year nor the tax cut. This page does not reproduce those two figures. It reports the analogous VAT (ICMS) legal-entity account. Registry attributes are the RFB extract 2026-03, which is later than the debts. CNAE enters as the division (two digits). Proposal of variables for the recoverability model (PGE-SP, 2026). PGE-SP seminar on active debt (2026). The seminar material reports mean collection 1.38% against a collectable share 27.05%. Year and tax cut are not stated. This page does not reproduce those two figures. ``` ::: ::: ## Question Which variables of the recoverability model are available in the VAT (ICMS) legal-entity extract, which are only partly available, and which are missing? ## Data No query. The rows are the proposal's variable list, translated and coded in the helper. The citation of the source material is printed by the setup cell. ## Method Each variable takes one status: available, partial, missing, or not applicable. Partial means the field exists and it is a proxy, or the lab does not load it in the form the proposal uses. Not applicable means the variable belongs to natural persons, which this lab does not analyse. ## How to read One row is one variable. Read the status column as an availability label. Read the caveat column for the limit of that field. Do not read a status as a share of stock or as a rate of recovery. ::: {#tbl-variables .cell tbl-cap='Variables of the recoverability model and their availability in the VAT (ICMS) legal-entity extract.' execution_count=2} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Count of variables by status: shape: (4, 2) ┌───────────┬─────┐ │ status ┆ len │ │ --- ┆ --- │ │ str ┆ u32 │ ╞═══════════╪═════╡ │ available ┆ 10 │ │ missing ┆ 11 │ │ n/a ┆ 2 │ │ partial ┆ 21 │ └───────────┴─────┘ ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
variable status source caveat
CDA number available ID_DEBITO, CDA_COMPLETA Never published. Aggregates only.
Debtor CPF or CNPJ partial CNPJ and CNPJ_ROOT, for the join The natural-person id is out of scope and is not read.
Debtor type, natural or legal person available Legal-entity filter of extract 1.3 Legal entities only.
Enrolment date available DATA_INSCRICAO
Date the credit was constituted missing No column
Nature of the credit partial TIPO_DEBITO The extract keeps VAT (ICMS). Five raw types map to declared, assessed or other.
Original enrolled value partial max of VALOR_SEM_HONORARIOS (max_value) DEBITO_RECEITA.VL_PRINCIPAL exists and is not used.
Updated value available VALOR_SEM_HONORARIOS in each monthly snapshot (stock)
Interest and fines partial DEBITO_RECEITA and GARE interest and fine columns Not used in these entries.
Consolidated total partial VALOR_COM_VH on DEBITO The lab uses the value net of legal fees.
Guarantee (flag, type, value, date) missing No guarantee table no guarantee table in the data; collectable share is understated.
Instalment: any, open, counts, break, adhesion date partial SOLICITACAOPARCELAMENTO The status is the status at extraction. It is not a dated status.
Instalment amount missing No amount column on the instalment table
Instalments paid or in arrears missing Only QTD_PARCELAS, the count on the request
Annual gross revenue partial Masked turnover, used in one existing section Not used in these entries.
Total assets, equity, employees missing No column
CNAE or sector available RFB registry, division Division only. The register is later than the debts.
Size (porte) partial porte on the RFB enrichment Loaded here. Section 3.14 does not load it.
Natural person: income and wealth n/a Out of scope Legal entities only.
Debtor's enrolled value and CDA count partial Derivable by CNPJ root inside VAT (ICMS) Other taxes are outside the extract.
Count of tax foreclosures partial AJUIZAMENTO and the filing status on the panel The filing status is already on the panel. The filing date is not loaded.
Count of suspended or instalment enrolments partial SITUACAO_DEBITO and the instalment table
Mean debt per CDA or per economic group partial Mean per CDA is derivable by root The economic group is missing.
Amount paid in five years, payment count, share of stock available GARE and the panel (paid, n_payments, rate)
Instalments settled or broken partial STATUS_PARCELAMENTO Extraction status. A settled request has no payoff date.
Spontaneous payments missing GARE does not separate spontaneous, instalment and enforced payments
Legal-entity registration status available RFB registry, section 3.14 The status is later than the debts.
Judicial reorganisation or bankruptcy partial situacao_especial on the enrichment Not loaded. Bankruptcy is not verified.
Natural person alive or deceased n/a Out of scope Legal entities only.
Assets: property, vehicles, vessels, aircraft missing No column
Equity holdings partial Partner links are pseudonymised Not used.
Protested, and the protest date partial Protest table Loaded here. The protest status is not dated. A null protest date is flagged.
CADIN, pre-enforcement annotation, credit bureau missing No column
Foreclosure filed, and the date partial Filing status is loaded; the filing date is not
Attachment, SISBAJUD, judicial guarantee missing No column
Administrative versus judicial phase partial Filing status on the panel
Secured, stayed or archived execution; statute of limitations missing SITUACAO_DEBITO is only a coarse proxy
Age of the CDA available age on the panel
Time from constitution to enrolment missing No constitution date
Time from enrolment to filing partial Filing date on AJUIZAMENTO, or the first filed snapshot Not recomputed here.
Time from enrolment to the first payment available Section 3.14 Kaplan–Meier
Time since the last payment partial Derivable from GARE Not computed here.
Amount recovered, dates, share, recovered yes or no available GARE amount, payment date, paid_flag, rate A payment in the year is not the same as recovery of the credit.
Recovered within 1, 3, 5 and 10 years partial Horizons of 1, 3 and 5 years for cohorts inside the window Ten years is not observed. The oldest cohort in the window does not reach it.

Full table: 44 rows. Scroll inside the box.

``` ::: ::: ## What not to conclude A variable marked available is not evidence that the credit is recovered. A missing guarantee table means any later classification understates the collectable class. Registry fields describe the firm at the register date printed above, which is later than the debts. The two percentages cited from the seminar material are not recomputed on this page.
